The 4 java.util.logging.LoggingPermission rows had a real cause: they used to reach SyntheticStub via an ambient Bridge scope plus register()'s retired-shadow re-tag which also sets kind_stated=true, until a with_category(SyntheticStub) refactor scoped the category directly at the call site and stopped tripping that re-tag, silently losing kind_stated with zero behaviour change.
